findings.name: A label whose name is only spaces is accepted and listed as an empty, nameless label
findings.summary: Two labels are created whose name is only whitespace. In the labels list they appear as tiny coloured pills with no text at all (only the colour chip, then "0 open issues/pull requests", Edit, Delete), and the heading count grows 15 → 16 → 17. There is no way to tell them apart from the list, and nothing was reported to the user. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/labels)
findings.expected: A whitespace-only name is rejected like an empty one (the field is marked required), with a message next to the Name field; no label is created.
findings.actual: Two labels are created whose name is only whitespace. In the labels list they appear as tiny coloured pills with no text at all (only the colour chip, then "0 open issues/pull requests", Edit, Delete), and the heading count grows 15 → 16 → 17. There is no way to tell them apart from the list, and nothing was reported to the user.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-iat14q7nt2yjqq6nojtsc.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/labels
Click "New Label"
Type five spaces into the "Name" field (the field is marked with a red asterisk as required) — nothing else
Type #778899 into the "Color" field (it must be filled explicitly, otherwise the save is refused)
Click "Save"
Repeat with two spaces for the Name and color #ab12cd

findings.name: Ticking a label in the PR sidebar Labels picker is not saved; it is only sent on a later click elsewhere
findings.summary: The row shows a ✓ but no request is sent at that moment; after a reload the sidebar lists only \"documentation\" and \"enhancement\" — agent8-normal was never assigned and no timeline entry exists. A request to /eval/harbor-handbook/issues/labels is only sent when the tester clicks somewhere else on the page afterwards (clicking the page background then saved it), so ticking a label and leaving/reloading the page silently loses the assignment. Seen 5 times of 5 (documentation twice, enhancement once, agent8-normal twice). (on /eval/harbor-handbook/pulls/5)
findings.expected: Clicking a label in the picker assigns it: the label chip appears in the Labels sidebar box, a timeline entry \"eval added the agent8-normal label\" is written, and it is still there after a reload.
findings.actual: The row shows a ✓ but no request is sent at that moment; after a reload the sidebar lists only \"documentation\" and \"enhancement\" — agent8-normal was never assigned and no timeline entry exists. A request to /eval/harbor-handbook/issues/labels is only sent when the tester clicks somewhere else on the page afterwards (clicking the page background then saved it), so ticking a label and leaving/reloading the page silently loses the assignment. Seen 5 times of 5 (documentation twice, enhancement once, agent8-normal twice).
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-iat14q7nt2yjqq6nojtsc.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/pulls/5 (my own PR "agent7 labels test: release captain docs"; the same happens on any issue/PR sidebar).
In the right sidebar click the "Labels" dropdown to open the label picker.
Type agent8-normal into the "Filter Label" box so only that label is listed.
Click the agent8-normal row once: a ✓ appears next to it and the row is ticked.
Reload the page (F5).
Look at the Labels box in the right sidebar and at the Timeline.

findings.name: The "Exclusive" checkbox cannot be ticked in the New Label and Edit Label dialogs
findings.summary: The Exclusive checkbox never ticks: clicking exactly on its square, clicking its "Exclusive" text, and focusing it and pressing Space all leave it an empty square, and after Save + reopening Edit it is still unticked. In the same Edit Label dialog, a click of the same kind on the "Archive Label" checkbox right below it ticks immediately (blue checkmark), so the two checkboxes behave differently. Browser hit-testing on the Exclusive control reports the surrounding form intercepts the click, while the Archive one resolves to its input. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/labels)
findings.expected: Clicking the Exclusive checkbox (or its label) ticks it, and Save stores the exclusive state so it is still ticked when the label is opened again — as happens with the "Archive Label" checkbox in the same dialog.
findings.actual: The Exclusive checkbox never ticks: clicking exactly on its square, clicking its "Exclusive" text, and focusing it and pressing Space all leave it an empty square, and after Save + reopening Edit it is still unticked. In the same Edit Label dialog, a click of the same kind on the "Archive Label" checkbox right below it ticks immediately (blue checkmark), so the two checkboxes behave differently. Browser hit-testing on the Exclusive control reports the surrounding form intercepts the click, while the Archive one resolves to its input.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-iat14q7nt2yjqq6nojtsc.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/labels
Click "New Label", type a name into Name and a colour such as #cc00aa into Color
Click the small square checkbox left of the word "Exclusive": nothing changes (two attempts, including a click on the "Exclusive" text)
Click "Save": the label is created with Exclusive off
Click "Edit" on that label (agent1-dblclick) and click the Exclusive checkbox again, then click "Save" and click "Edit" again: Exclusive is still unticked
In the same Edit dialog click the "Archive Label" checkbox just below: it ticks at once (blue checkmark)

findings.actual: The browser navigates to /eval/harbor-handbook/labels/edit and shows only the bare text \"Not Found\" on an otherwise blank white page: no app layout, no navigation, no explanation that the label was deleted. The typed edit is lost and the user must use the browser Back button to get anywhere.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-iat14q7nt2yjqq6nojtsc.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/labels

findings.name: Label counter says \"1 open issues/pull requests\" for a single item
findings.summary: The counter under a label with exactly one open issue or pull request reads "1 open issues/pull requests" — plural for a single item (seen on at least four labels: agent13-tl-renamed, agent2-three, agent4-ns/Bug Fix, agent8-renamed), while "2 open issues/pull requests" and "0 open issues/pull requests" use the same plural wording. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/labels)
findings.expected: The counter line is grammatical for the number it shows, e.g. "1 open issue/pull request" when the count is 1 (and plural only for 0 or more than one).
findings.actual: The counter under a label with exactly one open issue or pull request reads "1 open issues/pull requests" — plural for a single item (seen on at least four labels: agent13-tl-renamed, agent2-three, agent4-ns/Bug Fix, agent8-renamed), while "2 open issues/pull requests" and "0 open issues/pull requests" use the same plural wording.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-iat14q7nt2yjqq6nojtsc.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/labels
Scroll down to the rows of the labels "agent4-ns/Bug Fix" or "agent8-renamed" (each is assigned to exactly one open issue/pull request)
Read the counter line in the middle column of those rows: it says "1 open issues/pull requests"
Compare with the row of "documentation" (2) and any label with no issues (0): both also use the plural "open issues/pull requests"
